# Révise

> Your courses (PDF, Word, PowerPoint, photos of your notes) become sheets that cite the page each sentence comes from, spaced-repetition flashcards and a study plan up to exam day. A French web app (PWA) for students, in French and English.

Révise is in beta: payments are in test mode and no card is charged.

## What it does

- Imports PDF, Word, PowerPoint and photos, split into chapters.
- Sourced revision sheets: every sentence links back to the page of the course.
- AI-made flashcards and quizzes, with spaced repetition.
- Mock exams marked against a mark scheme, and past-paper analysis.
- A study plan up to the exam, plus grades and coefficients.
- A library of sheets shared by students in your field.
- Your courses stay on your device; sync with your phone through your Google Drive.

## Plans

- **Découverte**, €0: 1 active subject and 1 imported document; 3 AI generations (sheet, quiz or flashcards); flashcards, planner, grades and sync with your phone; the start of the library’s sheets.
- **Premium**, €39.99/year, that is €3.33 a month and €31.89 saved, at a price locked until you cancel. Or €5.99/month with no commitment (summer pause possible), or Express: €4.99 for 7 days on one subject, no renewal. 3-day free trial on subscriptions. Cancel in three clicks. Unlimited subjects and documents; AI sheets, flashcards and quizzes, with no generation limit; Marked mock exams and past-paper analysis; Podcasts, mind maps and questions to your course; Oral practice, videos and lecture recordings; The library’s sheets in full.

## FAQ

- **Is Révise free?** To start, yes: the Découverte plan is free, with no card, and includes one subject, one document and 3 AI generations. Premium opens everything, from €3.33 a month with the yearly plan.
- **How does the free trial work?** Your card is asked for, but nothing is charged for 3 days. Cancel before the end and you pay nothing. An e-mail reminds you of its end date as soon as it starts. The trial is offered once per account.
- **How do I cancel?** Settings, Subscription, “Cancel my subscription”: three clicks, no need to write to anyone. Premium stays open until the end of the period already paid, then nothing more is charged.
- **What if Premium isn’t right for me?** Write to us within 7 days of your first payment: you’ll be refunded, no questions asked.
- **What is Express?** A single payment of €4.99 for 7 days of Premium on one subject, with no subscription or renewal: for an exam coming up. Twice a semester at most. If you switch to yearly within 14 days, that €4.99 is taken off.
- **Can I pause my subscription over the summer?** Yes, with the monthly subscription: up to 3 months without payment, once a year. Your data is kept, and you can still cancel at any time.
- **I pay monthly: do I lose what I paid if I switch to yearly?** No. From your second monthly payment, what you paid over the last 12 months is taken off the yearly price.
- **Are my courses sent anywhere?** Your courses stay on your device. Only the passages a task needs are sent to the AI (Google’s Gemini), and Révise doesn’t keep them.
- **Is payment safe?** Payment goes through Stripe, which also handles invoices. Révise never sees your card number.
- **Do I need to install anything?** No: Révise works in the browser, on computers and phones. You can add it to your home screen like an app.
